0022600214.text: The Heat (3-6, third in the Southeast and three games back, ninth in the East) visit the Jazz (1-8, 14th in the West) with Miami on a one-game losing streak and 2-3 on the road. Utah has lost seven straight and is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain), all listed as out. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet this season, and their last meeting was a 115-111 Heat loss in Miami on February 9, 2026.
